summary: Build networks whose states evolve between discrete spikes, then distinguish biological modeling from machine-learning objectives.
outcomes: Trace membrane, synaptic and spike states through a small network.
Compare local, surrogate-gradient and conversion approaches at a conceptual level.
sequence: Introduce synaptic currents, delays and recurrent state
Encode a toy input as events
Separate biological learning rules from supervised objectives

Evaluate accuracy, latency and hardware assumptions
